settings.why: The complete starter setup. Good timing to get outfitted right as the fall feeding window opens up.
Reaction baits like this shine in early fall as bass feed aggressively ahead of winter.
A search bait built for exactly this. Fish are on the move, and a rattling lipless crank covers water fast to find them.
Stained, cooling fall water plus a vibrating blade is a proven combination.
Built for the murky, cooling-water conditions common on lakes and ponds this time of year.
Catfish stay very active well into fall. A good time to start if you haven’t yet.
As baitfish and vegetation thin out, fish tuck tighter to remaining cover. A jig flipped into it is a fall staple.
Still worth throwing during the low-light morning window before the water cools further.
Bait-and-bobber panfish action stays reliable into fall on most lakes and ponds.
Imitates baitfish schooling up in fall. Exactly what predators are keyed in on right now.

settings.text: Pick the kit that matches the fish you're after. Everything inside works together.
